name: Kinesis Semiconductor Wire Solutions India Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Kinesis Semiconductor Wire Solutions is India's first precision bonding wire manufacturer, focusing on localizing production for IDMs and OSATs.
summary: Kinesis Semiconductor Wire Solutions India Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing precision bonding wires, a critical material for semiconductor packaging. They are pioneering the localization of bonding wire production in India, serving Integrated Device Manufacturers (IDMs) and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) providers.
